items.question: What condition afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: The scope is eighty-four thousand in number.
These thousands are womb-diagrams or realms of birth.
Beings within them are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings situated in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are subject to torment.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
